pending_data: Tallas: CLAUDE-DEMO-001 da XS-XL por defecto; la tienda sartorial-atelier mostró 34-40 en bias-cut-slip-dress. Johandry fija la escala real de cada producto antes de importar (D-01-L).
Tallas «24 a 34» de pantalones y faldas: se exportan como 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34 (pares). Confirmar si son pares o correlativas.
Precios: los de CLAUDE-DEMO-001 (USD). La tienda sartorial-atelier tenía otro precio para el vestido (680 frente a 780).
Nombre LINEA NOVE: búsqueda de marca registrada pendiente (CLAUDE-DEMO-001 §Cero).

C-08 (Johandry, 2026-11-02): las descripciones ya no declaran origen geográfico, denominaciones de origen o de calidad, sostenibilidad, trabajo a mano, historia de la marca ni promesas de ajuste o rendimiento. Lo que queda (materiales genéricos, construcción visible, cifras de CLAUDE-DEMO-001) sigue en draft y se verifica antes de activar (D-01-catalogo-y-fotos.md).
Handle hand-framed-cotton-polo: el título pasa a Knitted Cotton Polo; el handle se conserva para no romper referencias. Johandry decide si se renombra antes de importar.

products.title: Serra Coat
products.body: Double-faced wool and cashmere, cut without a lining. Raglan sleeves and a waist without darts. Wrap closure with a belt in the same cloth.

products.title: Doppio Trench
products.body: Cotton gabardine with a dry-wax finish. Two layers across the back and a high centre vent. The belt fastens with a covered buckle.

products.title: Cocoon Cardigan-Coat
products.body: Alpaca knitted in an open stitch, without side seams.

products.title: Quilted Silk Liner
products.body: Washed silk with a down fill, quilted in four-centimetre channels.

products.title: Nove Blazer
products.body: Mid-weight wool, a natural shoulder without padding, one button and a high lapel. A floating canvas at the chest.

products.title: Cropped Tailored Jacket
products.body: A short version of the Nove Blazer, finished at the natural waist. Two buttons, jetted pockets without flaps and a single back vent.

products.title: Pleated Wide Trouser
products.body: Two inverted pleats from a high waistband. Lightweight wool with four percent elastane in the weft. Supplied unhemmed.

products.title: Cigarette Trouser
products.body: A straight, narrow leg, a high waistband and a concealed side zip. No front pockets.

products.title: Wool Waistcoat
products.body: A five-button waistcoat in the same cloth as the Nove Blazer, with a cupro back and an adjustable buckle.

products.title: Cashmere Rib Crew
products.body: Two-ply cashmere in a fine rib, with a crew neck and double cuffs.

products.title: Fine Merino Turtleneck
products.body: Extra-fine 19-micron merino with a high neck that folds over once.

products.title: Knitted Cotton Polo
products.body: A cotton knit polo with three corozo buttons and a flat collar.

products.title: Oversized Alpaca Knit
products.body: Alpaca in a chunky knit with a dropped shoulder and a short body. Made in two sizes, one and two.

products.title: Poplin Column Shirt
products.body: 120-thread cotton poplin, a straight body without darts and a length that falls below the hip. Semi-Italian collar with a soft interlining and a concealed placket.

products.title: Silk Charmeuse Blouse
products.body: Silk charmeuse with a shirt collar and covered buttons.

products.title: Striped Cotton Shirt
products.body: A woven stripe, not a print, in cotton. Single-button cuff and a centre pleat at the back.

products.title: Bias-Cut Slip Dress
products.body: Silk cut on the bias in four panels, with adjustable straps and a low back, without shaping seams.

products.title: Column Knit Dress
products.body: Merino knitted as a tube, without side seams, with a back vent at mid-calf.

products.title: Wrap Wool Skirt
products.body: A wool wrap skirt with a single visible seam and an inner tie.

products.title: Pleated Midi Skirt
products.body: Knife pleats in lightweight wool, a narrow waistband and a side closure. Mid-calf length.

products.title: Leather Belt
products.body: Single-layer leather, without reinforcement, with an unpolished brass buckle.

products.title: Cashmere Scarf
products.body: Cashmere in a diagonal twill, 180 by 45 centimetres, with a knotted fringe.

products.title: Structured Tote
products.body: Calf leather with a rigid base and stitched handles. One compartment, one inside pocket, no closure.

products.title: Silk Twill Square
products.body: A 90-centimetre silk twill square with a rolled hem.
